claims.text: The performance of the trained hotel2vec embeddings was evaluated through several experiments, including analysis of learning curves and model parameters.
The evaluation included comparing the enriched model against the session-only model, showing significant performance improvements in both filtered and unfiltered scenarios.
Empirical experiments were conducted to analyze the effects of various optimization algorithms and learning rates on model performance.
